title: machine-write-request
description: NX-062 M5c (ADR-041 §6; design §4): the body of POST /machine/v1/prepare (capability, intent_id, params) and of POST /machine/v1/commit (the same, plus the prepare_digest prepare returned). The client resends the full parameters at commit; the server keeps only their digest (C6) and recomputes it. intent_id is the client's own stable id of the business intent (8-128 characters), unique per machine client; the same intent with the same content answers its first result, with other content 409. The parameters are the capability's registered keys only; a field naming tenant, world, actor or client is refused (422). NexLoop target contract; server-derived identity required.
